children: New-home listing prices have barely moved over the past three years, Realtor.com says, even as existing-home prices have fallen. Rather than relying solely on lower asking prices, builders are offering reduced mortgage rates that can help buyers save on financing costs. The average starting mortgage rate for new-home buyers was 5.01% in 3Q, compared with 6.15% for existing-home buyers. On a $400,000 home purchase with 10% down, that difference translates to $258 less per month in interest during the first year of homeownership. Some of those reduced rates are temporary, so the initial savings may not last for the life of the loan. Builders may offer reduced rates through relationships with lenders or pay for a rate buydown on a buyer's behalf. (chris.wack@wsj.com)
